etsy.title: Christmas Stocking Sewing Pattern PDF, Lined Stocking With Cuff, 3 Sizes, Easy Beginner Sewing, Nikolausstiefel Schnittmuster
etsy.description:
Sew your own Christmas stockings this weekend: a lined stocking with a folded cuff and a hanging loop, in 3 sizes. Beginner friendly, about 1 hour.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• Stocking, cuff and loop pieces, 3 nested sizes: S 25 cm (10"), M 40 cm (16"), L 50 cm (20")
• A4 and US Letter print-at-home files with a test square, plus an A0 copy shop file
• Step-by-step sewing guide with fabric amounts and ideas (names on the cuff, faux fur, family set)
• Everything in English AND German (Deutsch): two downloads

GOOD TO KNOW
• No seam allowance included: add 1 cm (3/8 in)
• Works with cotton, flannel, felt, velvet; faux fur for the cuff
• Small makers welcome: sell the stockings you sew (please credit AureliaVenn)

PDF PATTERN ONLY – no physical item is shipped. Photos show the pattern pieces; no sewn sample photo yet.

Drafted with the help of software; sizes checked piece by piece. Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
